title: A Course in Deepening Sleep
summary: A course that builds on the first primers with a true deep slumber for a foe and a gentler easing of the sleeper's nightmares.

title: The Dream Walker's Intermediate Handbook
summary: A working handbook for the walker who now slips between waking and dream at will and shuts a foe into a pocket of sleep.

title: Treatise on Troubled Rest
summary: A treatise on the fretful sleeper that teaches how to drain fear and to undo the lingering weight of a bad dream.

title: The Lucid Dreaming Canon
summary: A canon on staying awake inside a dream so that the dreamer rewrites the scene and commands its shape.

title: A Manual of Shared Dreams
summary: A manual of dreams held by two minds at once that heals one dreamer and shuts another in a dream not of the foe's making.
